label: representative_chamber

recipe.name: gan_1um_720C
recipe.description: Synthetic 60-minute GaN growth at the provisional operating point (720 C, 1 um/h): heat-up, plasma ignition, growth with both shutters open, N-only droplet consumption, shutdown and cool-down. The performance-gate load case of PHASE1_CHAMBER_PLAN.md section 4 (one Ga cell and the N source; no Al). Not a machine recipe.

steps.name: ramp to growth temperature, plasma on
Ga off, N on (consume excess Ga)

vacuum.chamber_volume_m3.basis: order of a 200 mm production chamber; only sets V/S (0.1 s at 4 m^3/s)

heater.areal_heat_capacity_J_m2K.heater.basis: 1 mm pyrolytic-graphite-like element, 2200 kg/m^3 x 1700 J/kg/K

heater.areal_heat_capacity_J_m2K.ledge.basis: 2 mm Mo ledge, 10220 kg/m^3 x 280 J/kg/K

sensors.pyrometer.spot_radius_m.basis: 10 mm spot at the wafer centre

sensors.pyrometer.noise_K.basis: reading noise; the bias budget is +/-2 K (audit 2026-10-03)

sensors.pyrometer.valid_min_K.basis: Si opaque enough at the pyrometer wavelength above about 600 C

sensors.rate_monitor.window_s.basis: laser reflectometry needs about one interference period (~140 nm of GaN at 633 nm, 8 min at 1 um/h) per rate reading

events.name: ramp to growth temperature, plasma on
Ga off, N on (consume excess Ga)

performance.gate: accelerated completion within 60 min for a 60-minute recipe (PHASE1 section 4)

disabled_physics.coupling: Ga cell thermal dynamics and shutter flux transient
disabled_physics.effect: Cell assumed to follow its setpoint; real cells show a flux transient of a few percent for minutes after the shutter opens (machine-specific, measured at commissioning). Changes the first nm of a layer.

disabled_physics.coupling: Collisional crucible transmission versus cell temperature
disabled_physics.effect: Ga flux scales with p_vap/sqrt(T) from one DSMC record; DSMC held flux within 1.5 % over +11.5-13 K, so small within a few K of the reference.
10-20 s after each step (R20); flagged at each event.
Area fraction unknown; droplets persist until consumed by N.
R16: reading moved by >100 K at fixed thermocouple in an extreme case; not modelled.
Desorbing Ga and unused N not returned to transport.
Active-N output follows the feed through the MFC lag only.

disabled_physics.coupling: Hot cells and plasma source as wafer heat loads
disabled_physics.effect: Not in the heater model (steady model neither).
Rotation-averaged maps; partial revolutions at shutter events flagged.
